clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. A tall cone of roasting meat turning slowly on a vertical spit in a warm street-food stall at dusk, glowing heating elements, steam rising, a hand with a long knife shaves a thin slice, no face. Slow camera push-in. Curious mood. No faces, no text.
clips.credit: The döner spit: made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. A post-war Berlin snack stand in 1949 on an evening of light drizzle, warm lamp light, a woman seen from behind pours red-orange sauce over sliced sausage on a paper plate and dusts it with yellow curry powder, steam rising. Cosy, nostalgic mood. No face turned to the camera, no text.
clips.credit: The Currywurst story: made with Gemini Omni

clips.prompt: A painterly, warmly lit animated scene in the style of a modern illustrated storybook, soft brush textures. On a street-food counter at dusk, two hands, no faces, wrap a loaded flatbread sandwich in paper; beside it sits a paper plate of sliced sausage with red sauce and curry powder. Warm glowing lights. Joyful, satisfied mood. No faces, no text.
clips.credit: Both icons: made with Gemini Omni
